adjudication.reason: A reference-modified element under an ALL subscript (`N-EL (ALL) (1:1)`) is class alphanumeric by the 1985 text, and the argument-class screen classes it as its numeric element. MAX and MIN refuse legal lists; MEAN, MEDIAN and MIDRANGE compute from digit slices; an illegal MAX mix compiles and fails at run time. Not the mechanism of PB5780 or PB5813.
